clips.send: Other data make other shapes. Hours of video games vs score drift down: a negative association. Hours on the bus vs score show no clear trend: no association. Then back to our study data.

clips.send: Look for points that break the pattern. This student studied 6 hours but scored only 45, maybe sick on test day: an outlier. A group of points bunched together is a cluster: many students studied 2 to 3 hours.

clips.send: Common mix-up: Two things changing together does not mean one causes the other. Ice-cream sales and sunburns rise together, but the real cause is hot, sunny weather. Also, a line of best fit does not have to pass through any of the data points.

clips.send: Twelve students recorded two numbers: how many hours they studied for a test, and the score they got. Each row is one student, and each student gives us a pair of numbers.

clips.send: Use it to predict. A new student plans to study 4 hours. Go up from 4 to the line, then across: y equals 5.5(4) plus 53 equals 75 . We predict a score of about 75.

clips.send: Turn every pair into a point. Hours go across on the x -axis and the score goes up on the y -axis, so the student with (0.5, 55) lands here. Do it for all 12 and we get a scatter plot.
clips.text: Turn every pair into a point. Hours go across on the x -axis and the score goes up on the y -axis, so the student with (0.5, 55) lands here. Do it for all 12 and we get a scatter plot.

clips.send: Step back and look at the whole cloud. As hours go up, scores tend to go up too. This is a positive association. It is a trend, not a rule: this student studied more than that one but scored a little less.
clips.text: Step back and look at the whole cloud. As hours go up, scores tend to go up too. This is a positive association. It is a trend, not a rule: this student studied more than that one but scored a little less.

clips.send: Now sum up the trend with one straight line. Too flat misses the ends; too steep misses them the other way. The line of best fit follows the direction of the cloud, with about as many points above as below and the misses (pink) as short as possible.

clips.send: But be careful far outside the data. Stretch the line to 10 hours and it predicts 108 points, more than the maximum of 100! A trend line is trustworthy only near the data that made it.

clips.send: Read the line like any linear function: y equals 5.5x plus 53 . The slope 5.5 says each extra hour of study goes with about 5.5 more points. The y -intercept 53 is the predicted score for 0 hours.

clips.send: 现在用一条直线概括这个趋势。太平了，两端都差得远；太陡了，又往另一边偏。最佳拟合直线顺着点群的方向，线上方和线下方的点差不多一样多，而且每个点的偏差（粉色）尽量短。

clips.send: 再找找不合群的点。这名学生学了 6 小时，却只考了 45 分，也许考试那天生病了：这是异常值。挤在一起的一群点叫作聚集（簇）：很多学生都学了 2 到 3 小时。

clips.send: 把每一对数变成一个点。时长画在横轴（ x 轴）上，成绩画在纵轴（ y 轴）上，所以 (0.5, 55) 这名学生落在这里。12 名学生都这样画，就得到一张散点图。

clips.send: 别的数据会有别的形状。玩电子游戏的时长与成绩：点往下走，是负相关。坐公交车的时长与成绩：看不出趋势，没有明显的相关关系。然后回到我们的学习数据。

clips.send: 退后一步，看整团点。时长增加时，成绩往往也随之提高，这叫正相关。这是一种趋势，不是死规定：这名学生比那名学生学得久，分数却略低一些。

clips.send: 用它来预测。一名新同学打算复习 4 小时。从 4 往上走到直线，再横着看过去： y 等于 5.5 乘 4 加 53 等于 75 。我们预测他大约能考 75 分。

clips.send: 容易混淆：两个量一起变化，不代表一个导致另一个。冰淇淋销量和晒伤人数会一起上升，但真正的原因是炎热的晴天。另外，最佳拟合直线不必经过任何一个数据点。
